**Life.** Born to the 2126 generation. Grew up beside the underground storehouse at Sinjeong 2-dong. The post of District Chief opened for him through counting the storehouse stock to the very end on a midwinter night.
- Duty station: Sinjeong 2-dong. In the underground food storehouse at Sinjeong 2-dong, I Seodam checks the number of grain sacks against the fuel cans and allows removal only after confirming that every shutter is closed.

**Office.** Rank: District Chief. Title: District Chief of the Sinjeong 2-dong Food Storehouse. If a stock check sheet lacks a resident representative's confirmation, he issues no removal permit and seals the storehouse door.

Yi Seodam is the district chief of Yangcheon-gu and a direct subordinate of Han Jaemok. Her Yangcheon-gu domain consists of eighteen dong: Mok 1-dong through Mok 5-dong, Sinwol 1-dong through Sinwol 7-dong, Sinjeong 1-dong through Sinjeong 4-dong, and Sinjeong 6-dong and 7-dong.

**Anecdote.** A request to remove food comes down to the Sinjeong 2-dong storehouse without a check sheet. That same day I Seodam seals the storehouse door and tells the residents' representatives in each alley how the stock has dwindled.

**Relationships.** He cross-checks stock counts with the storehouse keepers of neighboring western areas and works out with them which households will run out of food first in each area.

**Ambition.** To publish food and fuel stock every winter so that no area ever goes hungry.

**Fear.** That word of the storehouse leaks out and demands arrive to hand over food in exchange for kidnapped or captured residents, turning the whole area into a bargaining chip.

**Intervention.** You can bring in the storehouse survey tables to back his seal, or expose the food missing from the ledger to shake the District Chief's confirmation.

**Life.** Generation of 2126. She grew up beside the storehouse in Yangpyeong 1-dong. Her post as ledger clerk opened through counting the storehouse stock to the very end on a midwinter night.
- Work location: Yangpyeong 1-dong. At the ledger desk in Yangpyeong 1-dong, Jang Pilgyu cross-checks the food and fuel counts of the storehouse copy against the area copy and records the circumstances of any missing ledger entry.

**Office.** Rank: Clerk. Title: Food Ledger Clerk at Yangpyeong 1-dong. She sends ledger copies to the storehouse and the area at the same time, but the final confirmation of removal quantities requires the clerk's seal.

**Anecdote.** In midwinter, when the storehouse food ran short, Jang Pilgyu spent the night cross-checking the ledger with the area representatives and recorded the confirmed quantity in the audit column.

**Relationships.** He cooperates with Yun Seorin by exchanging ratified contract copies but competes with her over interpretive authority, he disputes the wording of termination conditions with Jeong Yura, and he owes Yi Seodam a debt for covering up a past ledger omission.

**Ambition.** She aims to standardize the removal criteria of every western storehouse on the ledgers she has cross-checked herself.

**Fear.** That a single forged food ticket could invalidate an entire storehouse ledger and bring the ledger audit down as a political tool.

**Intervention.** You can find the forged ration ticket to protect his seal, or expose his marginal interpretation notes to neutralize the winter fuel release clause.

**Life.** Generation of 2126. He grew up beside the alley storehouse in Sinjeong 2-dong. His post as food distribution handler opened through counting the alley storehouse stock to the very end on a midwinter night.
- Work location: Sinjeong 2-dong. In the alleys of Sinjeong 2-dong, Im Bada posts food waiting tickets for each family. When a stock shortage is announced, he gathers the residents' representatives' confirmations to demand that the storehouse be opened, and asks for the cooperation of the other District Chief at the same station.

**Office.** Rank: District Chief. Title: Food Distribution Handler at Sinjeong 2-dong. He publicly posts the food waiting tickets for each alley, and when a stock shortage is announced, he gathers the residents' representatives' confirmations and demands the opening of the storehouse.

**Anecdote.** In midwinter, Im Bada counted the grain and fuel remaining in the Sinjeong-dong alley storehouse and spent the night setting minimum per-family amounts with the residents' representatives.

**Relations.** He aligns the order of food distribution with neighboring area handlers, holds a deep grievance over one-sided halts to removals on grounds of stock shortage, and follows the other District Chief at the same station like a patron.

**Ambition.** He aims to nail down in the area's rules a principle that preserves a minimum food line for every household even as winter food shrinks.

**Fear.** That evacuated residents will remain only as figures in food counts and be pushed off the waiting roster.

**Intervention.** You can measure the alleys short of food and enforce the minimum line, or expose the tampering with the waiting tickets and strip him of his standing as handler.

- Workplace: Sinjeong 3-dong. On the dispatch board at the Sinjeong 3-dong depot, Yu Sejin writes the order of food, maintenance and fuel, and notifies the maintenance desk of the departure time after brake repairs.

**Office.** Rank: Clerk. Title: Sinjeong Base Rail Passage Dispatcher. She writes the dispatch order on a public blackboard, but the dispatcher re-declares the order of food, maintenance and fuel every day, and punishes bribed dispatching by blocking the tracks.
